fields.name: id
fields.description: unique id number indicating the dishes (data format: integer)

fields.name: name
fields.description: the name of the dish (data format: text)

fields.name: description
fields.description: description of the dish (no value) (data format: text)

fields.name: menus_appeared
fields.description: how many menus have this dish (data format: integer)

fields.name: times_appeared
fields.description: how many times this dish appears in the menu commonsense evidence: if times_appeared > menus_appeard: this dish appeared in a menu more than once

fields.name: first_appeared
fields.description: the year that this dish appears first commonsense evidence: 1.	the year outside of [1851, 2012], it means this data is not correct 2.	if this dish lasts longer (last_appeared - first_appeard), it means its history is long or historical / classical (data format: integer)

fields.name: last_appeared
fields.description: the year that this dish appears the last time commonsense evidence: 1.	the year outside of [1851, 2012], it means this data is not correct 2.	if this dish lasts longer (last_appeared - first_appeard), it means its history is long or historical / classical

fields.name: lowest_price
fields.description: the lowest price of the dish commonsense evidence: 0: for free (data format: real)

fields.name: highest_price
fields.description: the highest price of the dish (data format: real)
